m: A *standing person* has tied a *ribbon* round her finger so she will remember: days later it is **still** there.
A *strong arm* works the *rice field* all day: in old China the field hand was the **male** of the house.
*Twin blades* cut a bar of metal into *gold coins*: that is how **money** is made.
A heavy *stone* drops on a drum's stretched *hide* and rips it: now the drum is **broken**.
Under an *archway* hangs a *lattice* of knotted cords: a fisherman's **net**.
A *helping hand* drops a *pill* of charcoal onto the *embers* and blows: the pot begins to **heat** up.
You climb a wobbly *stepladder* and a *strong arm* steadies it from below: that is what it means to **help**.
A *standing person* is hit by an *arrow landing* and a *standing knife* at once; he flips over and lands **upside down**.
Every *moon* the mother marks the wall to show how tall her baby has grown: she is **raising** a child.
A *lying man* under an *archway* sorts every *beetle* he finds into trays, each in its own **category**.
Two *persons* face each other on the *soil* of a field, resting their legs: they **sit** down.
Servants bow and hand a silk *towel* up to the throne: only the **emperor** gets such service.
A *hillside* fence and a guard's *glare* tell you how far you may walk: your path is **limited**.
A small *boat* is loaded with cargo and gets a cabin and a sail: now it is a proper **boat**, a ship.
Under the *moon* you peek out of your *tent* and the cold air hits your **face**.
The servant has an *ear* to the *curtains* and a *mouth* ready to report: listening is his **duty**.
On the *road* a cart shoots past a *tree* so quickly your *mouth* falls open: it is very **fast**.
A *person* carves a notch with a *standing knife* for each passing **moment** of the hour.
A child sees cake *crumbs* scattered on the floor and claps: the ants will be so **happy**.
Under the *awning* a fortune teller reads the *fortune stick*, but his *mouth* says no: he **denies** your wish.
The tailor at the *archway* snips with *scissors* and a *standing knife*: the coat fits **just** right, exactly.
A *woman* raises a huge *battle axe* over her head and everyone steps back from her **power**.
Three short strokes and one long *slide* curl off the brush like a single **hair** blowing away.
A *dog* sits on a *split log* while you trace its outline: you are drawing its **shape**.
Under a *lid* a machine rattles on and counts how many drops fall each minute: its **rate**.
A child with *legs* dangling sits on an *open crate* full of *candy* and eats it all: that is **excessive**.
A *prowling dog* stalks a single *bug*; no pack, no friends, just the dog **alone**.
The *king* kicks a ball into the fountain and *splashing water* goes everywhere: royal **ball** games.
A *boat* full of *war clubs*: what **kind** of boat carries those? A warship, of course.
*Antlers* hung on a *scaffold* in the *sun* for everyone to see: the sight is open to the **general** public.
My *standing heart* jumps when a *white dove* flaps suddenly in my face: I **fear** birds.
The *bow* is pulled back and the stone shot between its *horns* flies like a **bullet**.
Under a *tree*, by the *lid* of a desk and the *curtains*, children cut paper with *scissors*: it is **school**.
A *cross* is planted in the *grass* and a mourner's *mouth* tastes something **bitter**.
A *person* and a *bowing man* carve a block with a *standing knife*: together they **create** something new.
A *standing person* props up a *lying man* between *two planks* to look alive: the whole thing is **fake**.
Under a heavy *blanket* you *sweep* a slow arm out to stretch: you have slept a **long** time.
You pay with *gold coins* at the *hurdle* gate under the *sun*, but count them **wrong** and the guard shouts.
*Lifting hands* push up under *three planks* piled with bricks: they **bear** the weight.
A *kneeling man* presses a carved seal into the soft clay: he **prints** his mark.
The *sun* sinks behind the hills like a *bent knife* of light: it is **evening**.
Two long leaves like *horns* rise from *three planks* of a pot: an **orchid**.
With a *small speech bubble* saying "go", the boy fires a *tethered arrow* off the *workbench*: he **tries** it out.
Under the *moon* a soldier slaps his *war club* against his **thigh**.
A *hand* reaches out of a *tent* and puts its *mouth*-shaped cup in yours: **hold** this.
Under the *moon* you lie awake while your **brain** keeps thinking and thinking.
With an *elbow* bent, you cast a *fishing line* and read the *page* of tide times **in advance**.
A *small speech bubble* pops out beside a *sparrow* on the window: "**who** is there?"
The *dish* is full to the brim and overflowing: what a **benefit**, more than you need.
The *sun* rises over the *hillside* and warms the side that faces it: the **sunny** side.
A *left hand* holds a blade of *grass* to the *mouth* and blows: it **seems** like a bird singing.
A *mouth* calls out across the *hillside*: "**which** way is the village?"
*Footsteps* in the dust so small you need a magnifying glass: an ant's **tiny** trail.
A *lying man* is fed from a *spoon* by a kind Buddhist **nun**.
When the *silk thread* runs out, the weaver ties on a new one and **continues** the cloth.
Down the *road* comes a cart with *horns* on its bumper, under a wide *sky*: it **delivers** your parcel.
A *bent knife* and a *comb* are dropped as the *heart* races: something **urgent** has happened.
A *drop* of red falls into the *dish*: **blood**.
Your *standing heart* jumps when *crumbs* rattle in the dark: a mouse has **startled** you.
A *standing person* limps along with a bandaged leg: an **injury**.
A *seedling top* sprouts beside a *silk skein* still pale and undyed: plain, **white** raw silk.
Dried *grass* tied with *silk thread* is boiled, and a *ladle* pours it out: bitter herbal **medicine**.
On the *road* a shoemaker holds out a shoe; your *tongue* says "ah, it **fits**!"
*Water drops* ripple like a shaken *hide*: a **wave** rolls across the pond.
Somebody puts a *lid* over the whole sky and it goes dark: **night**.
You watch with a careful *eye* and take only a *pinch* of salt: you **save** the rest.
A tailor takes a *knife* to the cloth for a *shirt*: cutting comes **first**.
A *scholar* beams as drums play and a feast is served: he really **likes** a party.
A guard lays a *plank* across the gate and stands beside it to **guard** the town.
*Water drops* trickle from under a *cliff* where a *white dove* drinks among *crumbs* of rock: the river's **source**.
Under a *teepee* a hungry hunter's *glare* fixes on the pot: **food**!
A *tent* pitched on the edge of a steep *hillside*: one gust and it is in **danger**.
*Footsteps* stop on the *soil* and a *thumb* taps a watch: you **wait** for a friend.
On the *road* a showman performs a *magic trick* and then **tells** the story behind it.
Past the *hillside* rises a *mountain*: after weeks at sea, the sailors see **land**.
A child writes a *bracket* shape again and again on a slate, then closes the *lid*: daily **practice**.
A *fishing net* is hung on a wooden *cross* in the yard: **placed** there to dry.
A *lying man* rests by a *cross* on the door, with a *mouth* to feed: this is his **residence**.
Bent over the *grass* all day, cutting and carrying, the farmer **toils**.
A *shell* used as cash and a *green shoot* that grows: money that grows is **wealth**.
The *king* sits under an *awning* turning a *fortune stick* through a jade **ring**.
A *helping hand* sorts the birds with *spread wings* so they stand in neat rows: they **line up**.
At the *small altar* a *full jar* of rice is offered: the family prays for **good fortune**.
A *person* passes a *silk thread* through the *archway* and the gatekeeper **accepts** it as a gift.
Raise your *right hand* and give a big *yawn* of a laugh: everyone is **joyous**.
*Rain* pours on the *rice field* and a great crash shakes the sky: **thunder**.
In the *grass* a guard under a *blanket* hears a noise, bangs his *cane*, and his *mouth* and *speech bubble* shout a **warning**.
A *prowling dog* and a big *dog* run through the *grass* after the reapers: the **harvest** is in.
A *big man* stands under a *tree* in the *grass* and *sun* while artists copy him: he is their **model**.
With a *lid* under one *elbow*, a child on short *legs* runs to **fill** the jar.
A *bent knife* and a heavy *shell* purse are strapped to your back: you **bear** the load.
*Two planks* of sky and a curling *elbow* of mist: a **cloud** drifts by.
A *standing person* steps on a *nail* and has to **stop**.
A *cross* for the trunk and branches, *curtains* of roots below: a **tree**.
Through *water drops* you swim from one *square* to the next: you **tour** the town by canal.
A long tail curls out behind a *spoon*-shaped head: the **dragon** rises.
A *right hand* and a *thumb* press the soil around a young *tree*: you plant a **tree**.
A *spoon* and an *arrow* on the floor: who did this? You **doubt** everyone.
A *lying man* sleeps on *two planks* with an *elbow* under his head: the bunk bed has many a **layer**.
*Icicles* hang off a *teepee* and you hug your *elbow* to keep warm: it is **cold**.
*Water drops* surround a group of *islands* so big that together they make a **continent**.
The *icicles* are thrown straight at the *bullseye*: they **rush** ahead without turning.
Your *torso* turns, your *thumb* lets go of the string: you **shoot**.
*Trudging feet* cross a *rice field* and a *mouth* sketches the way in a few words: just a brief **outline**.
Rice *grass* is pressed into a mould by *water drops* while a *bowing man* checks it: a perfect **model** to copy.
The *music* stops and a pair of *legs* walks on stage **unexpectedly**: it is the singer's dog.
Under a *blanket* a *mouth* whispers one full **sentence** before sleep.
Under the *roof*, the *arrow landing* thuds into the wall: it has hit the **room**.
A *cobra* slides through the *grass* with two heads: it is very **different**.
*Water drops* splash as a *cane* slaps the pool: the fish are **aroused** into a frenzy.
With *water drops* on his *right hand*, a Han man washes in the Han River: the **Han** people.
Under the big *tree* a *thumb* points the way to the little **village**.
One *mouth* in a *tent* tells a joke and another *mouth* bursts out: "**ha**!"
With *bamboo* slips and a *tree* map pinned in the *archway*, the general draws up a **plan**.
*Water drops* fall like a curtain under the *roof* of the theatre: the actors **perform**.
A *bamboo* *gate* with the *sun* shining through: nothing fancy, just **simple**.
Something stuck *upstairs* and a *fortune stick* jammed across the stair: the way is **blocked**.
A *fishing net* drops over a bird with *spread wings*: caught in the act of **crime**.
The bull with *horns* is cut from the herd by a *standing knife* line: a fair-minded farmer must **judge** which is which.
At *sunrise* a *helping hand* lifts the pole across the shoulders: time to **carry** the loads.
Three rivers flow down with little dots of land between them: islands that make up a **state**.
A green bed of *moss* and a *bent knife* left lying still: the forest is **calm**.
On the *road* the soldiers meet the enemy's *glare* and **retreat**.
A *turned head* looks away from the empty bowl: dinner has **already** been eaten.
A *lid* of a collar over a *robe hem*: **clothes**.
A *standing person* bows with a *bent knife* of a smile, offers *crumbs* of cake from the *heart*: "after **you**, sir."
Under one *roof* an *altar* where the whole **sect** worships its ancestors.
Each *grain stalk* goes into a sack, its *mouth* tied, behind *curtains*: the store **accumulates**.
A *person* under a roof stores leftovers on a shelf: the **surplus**.
On a *sickbed*, clutching an *elbow* and a *bucket*: what **pain**!
Under the *tree* by the *tent* an inspector opens each bag: he **checks** everything.
A *sheep* climbs onto the *workbench* and ruins the work: it all goes **wrong**.
Under your *roof* a *full jar* of grain: you are **rich**.
A *comb* catches on fire at the *campfire* and you pull it out with **quick** hands.
A *cross*, a *strong arm* and *curtains* raised together: everyone **cooperates** to put up the tent.
A *bent knife* sits in the *bucket*, sticking out at the **corner**.
A *little fortune stick* stands in front of the *mouth* of the cave: this spot is **occupied**.
A *wine jug* and a *coiled rope* to hang it: they **match** perfectly.
*Footsteps* march toward the *goal line*: the army **recruits** new soldiers.
A man with a brush and three strokes of paint touches up the wall: he **repairs** and decorates it.
A *right hand* pulls back the **skin** of a fruit.
A *helping hand* pulls the *cloth cover* off a *cart* and **waves** it like a flag.
Under the *moon* a *seedling* still stands after the storm: **victory**!
Down the *hillside* go *trudging feet*, past a *cross* on the path: they **fall** lower and lower.
A *person* climbs the *hillside* step by step: **stairs** cut into the slope.
Under the *roof* a judge holds up the *skewer* to the light: he **examines** the evidence.
*Water drops* cover a *cloth cover* and *small table* that fell overboard: they **sink**.
*Soil* packed and stamped down hard until it is **solid**.
A sheep with a gentle *mouth* speaks softly: it is **kind** and good.
A *woman* rides a *horse* home to her children: **mom**.
